html:
Given text and a nonempty pattern, return every zero-based start index where the pattern occurs, allowing overlaps.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    "ababa",
    "aba"
  ],
  "expected": [
    0,
    2
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    "aaaa",
    "aa"
  ],
  "expected": [
    0,
    1,
    2
  ]
}
Hint

Try every possible starting position.

Complexity: O(n*m) time, O(n) output space

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises

solutions.name: substring-positions.py
solutions.code:
def solve(text, pattern):
    return [i for i in range(len(text) - len(pattern) + 1) if text.startswith(pattern, i)]
